title: 8-Day Cambodia Grand Dual-City: Angkor Temples & Phnom Penh Skyline
description: The definitive Cambodia golf experience. Connect Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor with Rosewood Phnom Penh, playing Faldo layouts across both cities.

signatureTour.title: The Khmer Kingdom Links
signatureTour.highlight: Our flagship 8-day signature tour featuring private temple scholars, domestic flights, and luxury penthouse suites across Cambodia.

inclusions.detail: All private luxury ground transport in both Siem Reap and Phnom Penh.
Business/Premium domestic flight connecting Siem Reap to Phnom Penh.
4 rounds: Angkor Golf Resort, Phokeethra, Vattanac (East), and Garden City.
4 nights at Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor + 3 nights at Rosewood Phnom Penh.
Private guided sunrise tour of Angkor Wat with expert archaeologist.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Siem Reap & Heritage Check-In at Raffles
itinerary.subtitle: Siem Reap Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Siem Reap and transfer to Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor. Settle into your heritage room.

Enjoy welcome drinks in the Elephant Bar followed by dinner celebrating royal Khmer cuisine.

itinerary.title: Faldo Mastery at Angkor Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Faldo Design Showcase
itinerary.imageCaption: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Angkor Golf Resort, navigating Sir Nick Faldo's bunkering and contoured greens.

Return to Raffles for an afternoon swim in the historic pool.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Angkor Wat & Phokeethra Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Heritage & Golf
itinerary.imageCaption: Phokeethra Country Club — Weerayudth Phetbuasak (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Phokeethra Country Club championship golf course Weerayudth Phetbuasak Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Witness sunrise at Angkor Wat on a private scholar tour before playing Phokeethra Country Club.

Spend the evening exploring Siem Reap’s craft markets.

itinerary.title: Flight to Phnom Penh & Rosewood Skyline Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Capital Transition
itinerary.imageCaption: Rosewood Phnom Penh — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Rosewood Phnom Penh luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Fly to Phnom Penh and check into Rosewood Phnom Penh atop Vattanac Capital Tower.

Enjoy sunset cocktails at Sora sky bar overlooking the Mekong.

itinerary.title: Khmer Architecture at Vattanac Golf Resort (East Course)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Faldo East Course
itinerary.imageCaption: Vattanac Golf Resort East Course — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Vattanac Golf Resort East Course championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play Faldo’s East Course at Vattanac Golf Resort, inspired by Angkorian heritage.

Return to Rosewood for an evening of French bistro dining.

itinerary.title: Asian Tour Venue at Garden City Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 4: Championship Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Garden City Golf Club — Weerayudth Phetbuasak (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Garden City Golf Club championship golf course Weerayudth Phetbuasak Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Conclude your golf rotation at Garden City Golf Club, testing your skills against rolling fairways and water carries.

Gather for a farewell banquet at Rosewood's Japanese robata grill.

itinerary.title: Capital Rest Day & Royal Palace Exploration
itinerary.subtitle: Cultural Rest Day
itinerary.imageCaption: Rosewood Phnom Penh — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Rosewood Phnom Penh luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Spend a relaxing day exploring the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda or enjoying the Sense Spa.

Toast the conclusion of your dual-city tour at Sora sky bar.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Phnom Penh Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Rosewood Phnom Penh — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Rosewood Phnom Penh luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast with panoramic views before checking out.

Your private executive transfer transports you to Phnom Penh International Airport for your flight home.

faqs.question: How is the transit between Siem Reap and Phnom Penh arranged?
faqs.answer: We include domestic business/premium flights taking just 50 minutes, with VIP baggage handling end-to-end.
